Joins the fields of a table to the features of a vector with the same value in a common field.

**Toolbox folder:** Vector Processing<br>
**Status:** Certified<br>
**Keywords:** Join, Vector, Table, Attributes<br>
**Authors:** Andrea Antonello<br>
**Class:** `org.hortonmachine.modules.VectorTableJoiner`

**Inputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inVector` | vector file |  |  | The vector to extend. |
| `inTable` | file |  |  | The table to join: a dbf file or the attribute table of a vector. |
| `fCommon` | String |  |  | The common field or, if it has different names in the two sources, the two names separated by a comma, first the one of the vector, then the one of the table. |
| `pFields` | String |  |  | The comma separated list of the fields of the table to join. |

**Outputs**

| Parameter | Type | Unit | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `outVector` | output file |  | The joined vector. |
